AppSettings.title: AppSettings
AppSettings.description: Global settings for the application, including company branding elements and theme color configurations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AppSettings entity.

companyLogoUrl.description: URL to the company's logo image, which will be displayed on the system login screen, all invoices, and other relevant system areas.

primaryColor.description: Hexadecimal color code for the system's primary theme color, influencing key interactive elements and branding accents.

backgroundColor.description: Hexadecimal color code for the system's background color, setting the overall visual canvas.

accentColor.description: Hexadecimal color code for the system's accent color, used for highlighting important information and interactive states.

SystemLog.title: SystemLog
SystemLog.description: An audit trail entry representing a single system or user action.

timestamp.description: The exact date and time the action occurred.

user.description: The email or identifier of the user who performed the action.

target.description: The collection or document ID affected by the action.
